description.value: The Wooden Spoon is a well-loved bistro in Grand Forks, BC, founded in 2013 and expanded in 2016, serving locally sourced breakfast and lunch with specialty coffee drinks. Reviewers consistently praise it as a surprising standout for road-trippers passing through the Boundary Country region, with highlights including Banh Mi sandwiches, house-baked doughnuts on Fridays, and an outdoor seating area. The restaurant also offers pre-made freezer meals and full off-site catering for events across the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at thespoon.ca provides clear evidence for address (221 Market Ave, Grand Forks, BC — appearing in footer across multiple pages), phone (250.442.5005), and business type (sit-down bistro serving breakfast and lunch with online ordering and take-home meals). No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging are mentioned anywhere on the site. A minor internal address discrepancy exists: the /contact/ subpage header shows '211 Market Ave' while the footer on all pages consistently shows '221 Market Ave', flagged as a concern.
concerns: Address discrepancy within website: /contact/ subpage header shows '211 Market Ave' but footer on all pages (including /contact/) shows '221 Market Ave'. OSM has no address to cross-check. '221 Market Ave' used as it is the more consistently appearing value.
OSM record has no address, phone, or email tags — contact details sourced entirely from website.

Bike-specific amenities are unconfirmed and should be verified on-site.
